notes.NOR: 地圖的挪威含斯瓦巴群島（北緯 77–81°），所以比只算本土冷：1991–2020 年平均 0.8 °C，World Bank 氣候知識平台（CCKP，同樣用 CRU TS、只算本土）是 2.2 °C
notes.CAN: CRU TS 的紐芬蘭島與拉布拉多南部約 40 個格子 2018 年起突然冷了 4–6 °C，周圍的格子沒有，比較像測站資料的問題；全國年均溫因此低了約 0.03 °C
notes.TWN: CRU TS 的全島面積平均含中央山脈，比平地測站低約 4 °C：2025 年 20.7 °C、1991–2020 年平均 20.2 °C。中央氣象署以 11 個平地測站代表臺灣，2025 年均溫 24.2 °C（1991–2020 年氣候值 23.9 °C）；年底記者會公布的全台平均（長期測站）是 24.53 °C。兩者的距平接近：2024 年 CRU 比常年高 1.0 °C、氣象署高 0.7 °C

notesEn.NOR: Norway on this map includes Svalbard (77–81° N), so it is colder than the mainland alone: 0.8 °C on average over 1991–2020, against 2.2 °C from the World Bank Climate Change Knowledge Portal (CCKP; also CRU TS, mainland only)
notesEn.CAN: In CRU TS, about 40 cells on the island of Newfoundland and in southern Labrador suddenly turn 4–6 °C colder from 2018 while surrounding cells do not, which looks like a station-data problem; it lowers the national mean temperature by about 0.03 °C
notesEn.TWN: The CRU TS island-wide area average includes the Central Mountain Range, so it is about 4 °C lower than lowland stations: 20.7 °C in 2025, 20.2 °C on average over 1991–2020. The Central Weather Administration's 11 lowland stations averaged 24.2 °C in 2025 (1991–2020 normal 23.9 °C); its year-end all-Taiwan average from long-term stations was 24.53 °C. The anomalies agree more closely: in 2024 CRU was 1.0 °C above normal and the administration's stations 0.7 °C
